name: Diamond DA42 / DA62
summary: Composite light twins with diesel piston engines; the DA42 is a common multi-engine trainer and the DA62 a larger touring twin.

wings: Long, slender glider-like wing with winglets
engines: Two compact diesel engines in slim, smooth nacelles
fuselage: Smooth composite fuselage with a large canopy (DA62 has gull-wing side doors and a longer cabin)

tellTales: Slender-winged composite twin with a T-tail and winglets
Long pointed nose and large canopy

confusedWith.howToTell: The Seminole has a metal fuselage with conventional side windows and a shorter, thicker wing; the DA42 is a smooth composite with long slender wings.
The Seneca has a conventional low tail and a riveted metal cabin; the DA42 has a T-tail and composite construction.
The Baron has a conventional low tail and a rounded metal fuselage; the DA42 has a T-tail and long thin wings.
The P2006T is a high-wing twin with a conventional low tail; the DA42 is a low-wing composite twin with a T-tail and long slender wings.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
